info.author: Savin Ionut Razvan
info.name: flexiai
info.summary: FlexiAI is a versatile and powerful AI framework designed to streamline the integration and management                 of OpenAI and Azure OpenAI services. With advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities,                  FlexiAI enables developers to build sophisticated AI-driven applications efficiently and effectively.
